note: Each entry's voter_verification is the v5 vector's JSON projection (byte arrays as JSON numbers). The records ride trailer 0x03 of the sealed bytes; trailers = the 0x05 / 0x06 part only. They are bound by the explanation digest (v6 field 8). A case verifies under v6 AND passes verify_commitment_voters(entries, issuer_aid, decision) with voters_verified records. A negative is refused by one of the two; rule is advisory. The gate body is gate_block_vector.json's answered_automate_with_certificate.
